expected_findings.description: The dead `[tool.setuptools.package-data]` stanza is misleading because hatchling is the build backend and includes package data automatically; remove both the stanza and its misleading comment.

`IMP_ARTIFACTS_DIR` is never injected by the engine, causing the spec gate to fail on any change with ID ≠ 0; the engine must inject the variable, or the script must receive the path via argument, or the fallback must be replaced with proper lookup.
`pytest.raises(Exception)` is too broad and masks unexpected errors; use `LoadErrors` instead, and change `configured_roles={"default"}` to `frozenset({"default"})` to match the type annotation.
Add a clarifying comment explaining that `coder` and `documenter` intentionally lack deny catch-alls because they require broad write access, unlike read-only agent steps.
